ValidationRule.description: If coupon used on is ticket, emd no and mileage equivalent should not be entered
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Used_On__c, "Ticket" )) && NOT(ISBLANK( CPN_Used_on_EMD_No__c )) && NOT(ISBLANK( Mileage_Equivalent__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please only enter EMD No. and Mileage Equivalent if the coupon is used on this item
